The '''Drunkard's Vote''' was a cantina located in the [[Senate Commercial District]] beneath the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Mariyk]] worked as a vendor in the cantina.
